list.query:
-- Aktive Challenger, jüngster zuerst
SELECT v.config || ' ' || v.variant || ' ' || to_char(v.created AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') AS __text,
       v.version AS __value
  FROM meta.model_version v
 WHERE v.role = 'challenger'
 ORDER BY v.created DESC

list.query:
-- Erstellzeitpunkt des jüngsten gültigen Laufs (Titel der Wochenpanels)
SELECT coalesce(to_char(max(issue_time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI'),
                'kein Lauf')
  FROM fcst.prediction
 WHERE target = 'load_actual' AND quantile = 0.5 AND value <> 'NaN'
   AND model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                   ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)
   AND issue_time >= now() - interval '17 days'

panels.title: 16 Tage: Lastprognose bis D+15 · Champion · erstellt ${lauf_last_champion}

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, code AS metric, value
  FROM energy.value_best
 WHERE code IN ('load_actual', 'load_da_forecast') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
 ORDER BY 1

-- Je Stunde der jüngste Lauf, der sie abdeckt (heute vergangene Stunden also aus
-- früheren Läufen), mit P10, P50 und P90 desselben Laufs. Läufe reichen höchstens
-- 17 Tage voraus, daher die Untergrenze für issue_time (Index statt Vollscan).
WITH lauf AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.valid_time) p.valid_time, p.issue_time
    FROM fcst.prediction p
   WHERE p.target = 'load_actual' AND p.quantile = 0.5
     AND p.value <> 'NaN'
     AND p.model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                  ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)
     AND p.issue_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '17 days'
     AND $__timeFilter(p.valid_time)
   ORDER BY p.valid_time, p.issue_time DESC)
SELECT p.valid_time AS time,
       CASE round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) WHEN 0.10 THEN 'P10' WHEN 0.50 THEN 'P50'
                                          ELSE 'P90' END AS metric, p.value
  FROM lauf l JOIN fcst.prediction p
    ON p.valid_time = l.valid_time AND p.issue_time = l.issue_time
 WHERE p.target = 'load_actual' AND p.model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                  ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)
   AND round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) IN (0.10, 0.50, 0.90)
 ORDER BY 1, 2

-- Wind + PV, alle EE und Residuallast (SMARD: Last − Wind − PV), je Stunde gemittelt, weil
-- Quellen in Viertelstunden oder Stunden liefern. EE gesamt nur, wenn Wind und PV vollständig
-- sind (Biomasse, Wasser und sonstige EE kommen hinzu, soweit vorhanden).
WITH h AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS t, code, avg(value) AS v
    FROM energy.value_best
   WHERE code IN ('gen_wind_onshore', 'gen_wind_offshore', 'gen_solar', 'gen_biomass',
                  'gen_hydro', 'gen_other_renewable', 'residual_load',
                  'residual_load_da_forecast')
     AND $__timeFilter(ts)
   GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT t AS time, 'ist_wind_pv' AS metric, sum(v) AS value
  FROM h WHERE code IN ('gen_wind_onshore', 'gen_wind_offshore', 'gen_solar')
 GROUP BY t HAVING count(*) = 3
UNION ALL
SELECT t, 'ist_ee', sum(v)
  FROM h WHERE code NOT LIKE 'residual%'
 GROUP BY t
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE code IN ('gen_wind_onshore', 'gen_wind_offshore', 'gen_solar')) = 3
UNION ALL
SELECT t, code, v FROM h WHERE code LIKE 'residual%'
 ORDER BY 1, 2

-- Stufe 1 des Modells: Wind + PV und Residuallast (Last − Wind − PV) aus den P50 desselben
-- Laufs, je Stunde der jüngste Lauf wie bei der Lastprognose. Stufe 2 (Preis) rechnet mit
-- genau dieser Residuallast.
WITH lauf AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.valid_time) p.valid_time, p.issue_time
    FROM fcst.prediction p
   WHERE p.target = 'load_actual' AND p.quantile = 0.5
     AND p.value <> 'NaN'
     AND p.model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                            ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)
     AND p.issue_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '17 days'
     AND $__timeFilter(p.valid_time)
   ORDER BY p.valid_time, p.issue_time DESC),
s1 AS (
  SELECT p.valid_time, p.target, p.value
    FROM lauf l JOIN fcst.prediction p
      ON p.valid_time = l.valid_time AND p.issue_time = l.issue_time
   WHERE p.model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                            ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)
     AND p.quantile = 0.5 AND p.value <> 'NaN'
     AND p.target IN ('load_actual', 'gen_wind_onshore', 'gen_wind_offshore', 'gen_solar'))
SELECT valid_time AS time, 'prog_wind_pv' AS metric,
       sum(value) FILTER (WHERE target <> 'load_actual') AS value
  FROM s1 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE target <> 'load_actual') = 3
UNION ALL
SELECT valid_time, 'prog_residual_load',
       sum(CASE WHEN target = 'load_actual' THEN value ELSE -value END)
  FROM s1 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) = 4
 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Zeitraum des Dashboards (Standard heute 00:00 bis Ende D+15, Ortszeit) mit der Prognose des aktuellen Champions: Median P50 als Linie, das Band P10–P90 (nominell 80 %) als grauer Schlauch. Je Stunde gilt der jüngste Lauf, der sie abdeckt; vergangene Stunden von heute stammen daher aus früheren Läufen. Zum Vergleich die Last (gelb) und die Day-Ahead-Lastprognose der ÜNB (gelb gestrichelt), soweit vorhanden. Sichtbar ist außerdem die Residuallast = Last − Wind − PV (orange: Ist aus SMARD, hell: Modellprognose aus Stufe 1, P50 desselben Laufs, mit der auch der Preis rechnet, gestrichelt: Prognose der ÜNB). Ausgeblendet und über die Legende zuschaltbar (Klick zeigt nur diese Serie, Strg-Klick schaltet sie dazu): Wind + PV (grün) und EE gesamt mit Biomasse, Wasser und sonstigen EE (dunkelgrün), jeweils als Ist und als Modellprognose (hell).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, code AS metric, value
  FROM energy.value_best
 WHERE code IN ('da_price_de_lu') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
 ORDER BY 1

-- Je Stunde der jüngste Lauf, der sie abdeckt (heute vergangene Stunden also aus
-- früheren Läufen), mit P10, P50 und P90 desselben Laufs. Läufe reichen höchstens
-- 17 Tage voraus, daher die Untergrenze für issue_time (Index statt Vollscan).
WITH lauf AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.valid_time) p.valid_time, p.issue_time
    FROM fcst.prediction p
   WHERE p.target = 'da_price_de_lu' AND p.quantile = 0.5
     AND p.value <> 'NaN'
     AND p.model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                  ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)
     AND p.issue_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '17 days'
     AND $__timeFilter(p.valid_time)
   ORDER BY p.valid_time, p.issue_time DESC)
SELECT p.valid_time AS time,
       CASE round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) WHEN 0.10 THEN 'P10' WHEN 0.50 THEN 'P50'
                                          ELSE 'P90' END AS metric, p.value
  FROM lauf l JOIN fcst.prediction p
    ON p.valid_time = l.valid_time AND p.issue_time = l.issue_time
 WHERE p.target = 'da_price_de_lu' AND p.model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                  ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)
   AND round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) IN (0.10, 0.50, 0.90)
 ORDER BY 1, 2

-- Tagesmittel je Liefertag (Ortszeit), als Punkt um 12:00: Preis gewichtet mit dem
-- H0-Profil (meta.slp_h0_gewicht), Fehlerbalken aus P10 und P90 gleich gewichtet, auf Wunsch
-- zusätzlich lastgewichtet. Bekannte Stunden nehmen den Day-Ahead-Preis (und die Ist-Last bzw.
-- ÜNB-Lastprognose), die übrigen die Prognose wie in refId B (jüngster Lauf je Stunde).
-- Fehlerbalken: je Tag eigene Reihen (senkrechter Strich, Kappe unten, Kappe oben), da
-- jede Reihe nur ihre eigenen Punkte verbindet (spanNulls über die Lücken aus dem Join).
WITH lauf AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.valid_time) p.valid_time, p.issue_time
    FROM fcst.prediction p
   WHERE p.target = 'da_price_de_lu' AND p.quantile = 0.5
     AND p.value <> 'NaN'
     AND p.model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                  ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)
     AND p.issue_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '17 days'
     AND $__timeFilter(p.valid_time)
   ORDER BY p.valid_time, p.issue_time DESC),
lauf_last AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.valid_time) p.valid_time, p.issue_time
    FROM fcst.prediction p
   WHERE p.target = 'load_actual' AND p.quantile = 0.5
     AND p.value <> 'NaN'
     AND p.model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                  ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)
     AND p.issue_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '17 days'
     AND $__timeFilter(p.valid_time)
   ORDER BY p.valid_time, p.issue_time DESC),
pq AS (
  SELECT p.valid_time AS t,
         max(p.value) FILTER (WHERE round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) = 0.10) AS p10,
         max(p.value) FILTER (WHERE round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) = 0.50) AS p50,
         max(p.value) FILTER (WHERE round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) = 0.90) AS p90
    FROM lauf l JOIN fcst.prediction p
      ON p.valid_time = l.valid_time AND p.issue_time = l.issue_time
   WHERE p.target = 'da_price_de_lu' AND p.model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                  ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)
   GROUP BY 1),
lp AS (
  SELECT p.valid_time AS t, p.value
    FROM lauf_last l JOIN fcst.prediction p
      ON p.valid_time = l.valid_time AND p.issue_time = l.issue_time
   WHERE p.target = 'load_actual' AND p.model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                  ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1) AND p.quantile = 0.5),
ist AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS t,
         avg(value) FILTER (WHERE code = 'da_price_de_lu') AS preis,
         avg(value) FILTER (WHERE code = 'load_actual') AS last,
         avg(value) FILTER (WHERE code = 'load_da_forecast') AS last_uenb
    FROM energy.value_best
   WHERE code IN ('da_price_de_lu', 'load_actual', 'load_da_forecast') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
   GROUP BY 1),
h AS (
  SELECT (pq.t AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date AS d,
         meta.slp_h0_gewicht(pq.t AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AS w,
         coalesce(i.preis, pq.p50) AS m, coalesce(i.preis, pq.p10) AS lo,
         coalesce(i.preis, pq.p90) AS hi, coalesce(i.last, i.last_uenb, lp.value) AS last
    FROM pq LEFT JOIN ist i USING (t) LEFT JOIN lp USING (t)),
tag AS (
  SELECT (d + time '12:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t,
         sum(m * w) / sum(w) AS h0, sum(lo * w) / sum(w) AS h0_lo, sum(hi * w) / sum(w) AS h0_hi,
         sum(m * last) / sum(last) AS lastw
    FROM h GROUP BY d HAVING count(m) >= 23)
SELECT t AS time, 'Tagesmittel H0' AS metric, h0 AS value FROM tag
UNION ALL SELECT t + z, 'FB ' || to_char(t, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || k, v
  FROM tag, LATERAL (VALUES (interval '0', '', h0_lo), (interval '1 second', '', h0_hi),
    (interval '-40 minutes', ' unten', h0_lo), (interval '40 minutes', ' unten', h0_lo),
    (interval '-40 minutes', ' oben', h0_hi), (interval '40 minutes', ' oben', h0_hi)) f(z, k, v)
 WHERE h0_hi > h0_lo
UNION ALL SELECT t, 'Tagesmittel Last', lastw FROM tag WHERE '${tagesmittel_last}' = 'an'
 ORDER BY 1, 2

Je Stunde gilt der jüngste Lauf, der sie abdeckt; vergangene Stunden von heute stammen daher aus früheren Läufen. Zum Vergleich der Day-Ahead-Preis (sobald veröffentlicht, auch für morgen). Je Tag um 12:00 das Tagesmittel des Preises, gewichtet mit dem BDEW-Haushaltsprofil H0 (orange, roter Strich = H0-gewichtetes P10 bis P90); mit dem Schalter „Tagesmittel lastgewichtet“ oben zusätzlich mit der Last gewichtet (Ist-Last, sonst ÜNB-Prognose, sonst Lastprognose desselben Modells). SELECT p.valid_time AS time,
       CASE round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) WHEN 0.10 THEN 'P10' WHEN 0.50 THEN 'P50'
                                          ELSE 'P90' END AS metric, p.value
  FROM lauf l JOIN fcst.prediction p
    ON p.valid_time = l.valid_time AND p.issue_time = l.issue_time
 WHERE p.target = 'da_price_de_lu' AND p.model_version = '${challenger}'
   AND round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) IN (0.10, 0.50, 0.90)
 ORDER BY 1, 2

-- Tagesmittel je Liefertag (Ortszeit), als Punkt um 12:00: Preis gewichtet mit dem
-- H0-Profil (meta.slp_h0_gewicht), Fehlerbalken aus P10 und P90 gleich gewichtet, auf Wunsch
-- zusätzlich lastgewichtet. Bekannte Stunden nehmen den Day-Ahead-Preis (und die Ist-Last bzw.
-- ÜNB-Lastprognose), die übrigen die Prognose wie in refId B (jüngster Lauf je Stunde).
-- Fehlerbalken: je Tag eigene Reihen (senkrechter Strich, Kappe unten, Kappe oben), da
-- jede Reihe nur ihre eigenen Punkte verbindet (spanNulls über die Lücken aus dem Join).
WITH lauf AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.valid_time) p.valid_time, p.issue_time
    FROM fcst.prediction p
   WHERE p.target = 'da_price_de_lu' AND p.quantile = 0.5
     AND p.value <> 'NaN'
     AND p.model_version = '${challenger}'
     AND p.issue_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '17 days'
     AND $__timeFilter(p.valid_time)
   ORDER BY p.valid_time, p.issue_time DESC),
lauf_last AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.valid_time) p.valid_time, p.issue_time
    FROM fcst.prediction p
   WHERE p.target = 'load_actual' AND p.quantile = 0.5
     AND p.value <> 'NaN'
     AND p.model_version = '${challenger}'
     AND p.issue_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '17 days'
     AND $__timeFilter(p.valid_time)
   ORDER BY p.valid_time, p.issue_time DESC),
pq AS (
  SELECT p.valid_time AS t,
         max(p.value) FILTER (WHERE round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) = 0.10) AS p10,
         max(p.value) FILTER (WHERE round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) = 0.50) AS p50,
         max(p.value) FILTER (WHERE round(p.quantile::numeric, 2) = 0.90) AS p90
    FROM lauf l JOIN fcst.prediction p
      ON p.valid_time = l.valid_time AND p.issue_time = l.issue_time
   WHERE p.target = 'da_price_de_lu' AND p.model_version = '${challenger}'
   GROUP BY 1),
lp AS (
  SELECT p.valid_time AS t, p.value
    FROM lauf_last l JOIN fcst.prediction p
      ON p.valid_time = l.valid_time AND p.issue_time = l.issue_time
   WHERE p.target = 'load_actual' AND p.model_version = '${challenger}' AND p.quantile = 0.5),
ist AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS t,
         avg(value) FILTER (WHERE code = 'da_price_de_lu') AS preis,
         avg(value) FILTER (WHERE code = 'load_actual') AS last,
         avg(value) FILTER (WHERE code = 'load_da_forecast') AS last_uenb
    FROM energy.value_best
   WHERE code IN ('da_price_de_lu', 'load_actual', 'load_da_forecast') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
   GROUP BY 1),
h AS (
  SELECT (pq.t AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date AS d,
         meta.slp_h0_gewicht(pq.t AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AS w,
         coalesce(i.preis, pq.p50) AS m, coalesce(i.preis, pq.p10) AS lo,
         coalesce(i.preis, pq.p90) AS hi, coalesce(i.last, i.last_uenb, lp.value) AS last
    FROM pq LEFT JOIN ist i USING (t) LEFT JOIN lp USING (t)),
tag AS (
  SELECT (d + time '12:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t,
         sum(m * w) / sum(w) AS h0, sum(lo * w) / sum(w) AS h0_lo, sum(hi * w) / sum(w) AS h0_hi,
         sum(m * last) / sum(last) AS lastw
    FROM h GROUP BY d HAVING count(m) >= 23)
SELECT t AS time, 'Tagesmittel H0' AS metric, h0 AS value FROM tag
UNION ALL SELECT t + z, 'FB ' || to_char(t, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || k, v
  FROM tag, LATERAL (VALUES (interval '0', '', h0_lo), (interval '1 second', '', h0_hi),
    (interval '-40 minutes', ' unten', h0_lo), (interval '40 minutes', ' unten', h0_lo),
    (interval '-40 minutes', ' oben', h0_hi), (interval '40 minutes', ' oben', h0_hi)) f(z, k, v)
 WHERE h0_hi > h0_lo
UNION ALL SELECT t, 'Tagesmittel Last', lastw FROM tag WHERE '${tagesmittel_last}' = 'an'
 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Zeitraum des Dashboards (Standard heute 00:00 bis Ende D+15, Ortszeit) mit der Prognose des oben gewählten Challengers (Variable Challenger): Median P50 als Linie, das Band P10–P90 (nominell 80 %) als grauer Schlauch. Je Stunde gilt der jüngste Lauf, der sie abdeckt; vergangene Stunden von heute stammen daher aus früheren Läufen. Zum Vergleich der Day-Ahead-Preis (sobald veröffentlicht, auch für morgen). Je Tag um 12:00 das Tagesmittel des Preises, gewichtet mit dem BDEW-Haushaltsprofil H0 (orange, roter Strich = H0-gewichtetes P10 bis P90); mit dem Schalter „Tagesmittel lastgewichtet“ oben zusätzlich mit der Last gewichtet (Ist-Last, sonst ÜNB-Prognose, sonst Lastprognose desselben Modells). Stunden mit bekanntem Day-Ahead-Preis gehen mit diesem ein.

panels.title: Morgen: Preis mit D+1 bis D+15 · Champion

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, code AS metric, value
  FROM energy.value_best
 WHERE code IN ('da_price_de_lu') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
 ORDER BY 1

-- Je Vorlauftag n die Prognose vom Tag n vor dem Liefertag, 10:00 Ortszeit (wie in den
-- Vergleichspanels: zeitgleich mit der Day-Ahead-Lastprognose der ÜNB)
SELECT p.valid_time AS time,
       'D+' || ((p.valid_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date
                - (p.issue_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date) AS metric, p.value
  FROM fcst.prediction p
 WHERE p.target = 'da_price_de_lu' AND p.quantile = 0.5
   AND p.model_version = (SELECT version FROM meta.model_version WHERE role = 'champion'
                            ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)
   AND extract(hour FROM p.issue_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 10
   AND $__timeFilter(p.valid_time)
 ORDER BY 1, 2

options.content:
**Prognose:** eigene Modelle von [PredictionDB](https://github.com/the78mole/PredictionDB) (Champion und ein Challenger), Median P50 mit Band P10–P90. Die Panels „Morgen“ zeigen je Vorlauftag D+n den Lauf von 10:00 Uhr n Tage vor dem Liefertag, dazu die Lastprognose der ÜNB bzw. den Day-Ahead-Preis. Tagesmittel gewichtet mit dem BDEW-Standardlastprofil H0 (Werte über [demandlib](https://github.com/oemof/demandlib), MIT).

**Daten:** Day-Ahead-Preis DE-LU und Netzlast: Bundesnetzagentur | [SMARD.de](https://www.smard.de) (CC BY 4.0), [Energy-Charts](https://www.energy-charts.info) (Fraunhofer ISE, CC BY 4.0), ENTSO-E Transparency Platform. Wetter: NOAA/NCEP GFS und GEFS (gemeinfrei). Anlagenbestand: Marktstammdatenregister (DL-DE BY 2.0). Keine Gewähr.
